summary.text: Timmy Truett is a Republican state representative who has represented District 89 since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Timmy Truett lives in McKee, Kentucky, and earned a master's degree in education.
His career experience includes working as principal of McKee Elementary School.

He has served on the House committees for Appropriations and Revenue, Economic Development and Workforce Investment, Postsecondary Education, Tourism and Outdoor Recreation, and Primary and Secondary Education during the 2025-2026 session.
